report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors. The only deployment record is a baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, and order logs show all /v1/orders requests returning 200 with successful postgres, inventory and payment calls. Metrics show zero 502s on /v1/orders. No checkout error is observed, so no bounded cause can be established.
missing_evidence: Evidence of actual checkout errors (non-2xx /v1/orders responses or error logs) in the incident window
Deployment records showing a version change preceding any error onset
Telemetry from the checkout service itself, not only the order service
Error-level logs or traces correlating failures to a specific dependency or version
